versions.changelog:
Version 3.0.0 introduces a safer, more auditable, and extensible approach to web search rule management across multiple knowledge platforms.

- Adds support for new platforms: Feishu Wiki, DingTalk Docs, and custom adapters, alongside IMA, Tencent Docs, Obsidian, and NotebookLM.
- Moves configuration and audit log storage to `~/.skill-config/web-search-rules-en/` with explicit migration guidance for legacy configs.
- Implements a strict security model: local staging by default, no credential storage, and double-confirmation for risky operations (cloud upload, deletion, migration, browser automation).
- Formalizes an audit log for all write, archive, migration, and deletion actions.
- Provides a structured rule engine with conflict handling, normalization, prioritized classification, and user override checks.
- Includes extensive reference guides for platform adapters, safe operations, and migration workflows.

No code or documentation changes detected for version 2.0.2.

- Re-release or metadata update only; no functional or content changes.
- All workflows, features, and documentation remain unchanged from previous version.

Version 2.0.1

- Added SECURITY.md with important security guidance for users.
- Updated SKILL.md to include prominent security notices and references to SECURITY.md.
- Clarified requirements for file system and browser automation permissions.
- Improved warnings about configuration file paths and Vault directory validation.
- No changes to workflows or core features; documentation updates only.

A web search rules management skill with 5-platform support (IMA, Tencent Docs, Obsidian, NotebookLM, Others). Automatically manages search URL library (whitelist, blacklist, uncategorized), temporarily stores search content, and organizes/archives after user confirmation. New: Obsidian (local Markdown knowledge management) and NotebookLM (Google AI-assisted analysis) support.

v2.0.0 (2026-05-05)- 
- Added support for IMA Knowledge Base, Tencent Docs, Obsidian, NotebookLM, and custom platforms.
- Implements automatic management of search URL library: whitelist, blacklist, and uncategorized URLs.
- Introduces content staging, with temporary storage of search results pending user confirmation.
- Automatically filters search results based on whitelist/blacklist.
- Onboards new users with knowledge base platform selection and setup workflow.
- Organizes and archives confirmed content to the selected knowledge base platform.
